QuestInfo.name: [Gold Beach] Status Report
QuestInfo.1: Take the #t4033632# from #p1082000# to Little Richie.
QuestInfo.2: Little Richie ordered you to eliminate all Black Slimes. Then he drank his slushy drink.

0.0: Take this drink to Little Richie. Maybe he'll forget about his stupid report.

yes.0: The supply boat hasn't checked in, and that means I won't have any eggs for breakfast, and THAT means I'm going to be angry for at least a week. Take this drink out of my hand before I smash the glass against my head.

no.0: Are you a little busy right now? Come back when you have the time.

1.0: Did you talk to #p1082000# about the report?

yes.0: Oh hey, a #t4033632#! My favorite! Forget about the... what did I ask you to do? Who cares? I'm late for my daily mud-scrub foot pounding.

npc.0: Did you take that #t4033632# to Little Richie?
